review_scope: Targeted bilingual review of ten headlines, all flagged entries, reproducible samples, volume arithmetic, currencies and tracking identifiers. Follow-up review of parcel and quote polysemy.

reviewed_flags.resolution: Croatian bank statement and exchange-rate comparison preserves the transaction context.
Croatian paragraph distinguishes the updated dispatch notice from the original carton list.
Croatian measurement paragraph distinguishes the original item list and the revised packing scenario.

corrections.translation: Kako zadati upute za pakiranje prije procjene troška dostave u Superbuyu

corrections.translation: Kupnja preko posrednika ili prosljeđivanje paketa: koji zahtjev podnijeti u Superbuyu?

corrections.source: Tracking Superbuy photo and packing requests from instruction to result
corrections.translation: Kako pratiti zahtjeve za fotografiranje i pakiranje u Superbuyu do provjere rezultata

corrections.source: For a rectangular box, multiply length by width by height to compare volumes. If an illustrative first estimate uses 40 by 25 by 15 centimetres, the rectangular volume is 15,000 cubic centimetres. A measured outer package of 42 by 28 by 18 is 21,168 cubic centimetres. The difference is 6,168 cubic centimetres, around 41 percent more space than the estimate.
corrections.translation: Za usporedbu obujma pravokutnih kutija pomnožite duljinu, širinu i visinu. Početna procjena od 40 × 25 × 15 cm daje 15.000 cm³. Ako vanjska ambalaža nakon mjerenja ima 42 × 28 × 18 cm, zauzima 21.168 cm³. Razlika iznosi 6.168 cm³, približno 41 posto više prostora od procjene.

corrections.source: For an illustrative calculation, a packed parcel measuring 40 by 30 by 20 centimetres occupies 24,000 cubic centimetres. A second packing option measuring 40 by 30 by 15 occupies 18,000. That is a reduction of 6,000 cubic centimetres, or one quarter of the first volume. It does not follow that the shipping charge falls by one quarter. Check each eligible route's actual billing and size rules and whether the protective treatment still meets your needs.
corrections.translation: U primjeru zapakirani paket dimenzija 40 × 30 × 20 cm zauzima 24.000 cm³. Druga ambalaža od 40 × 30 × 15 cm zauzima 18.000 cm³. Smanjenje od 6.000 cm³ čini četvrtinu početnog obujma. To ne znači da će se cijena dostave smanjiti za četvrtinu. Za svaku dostupnu opciju provjerite obračun cijene i ograničenja dimenzija te pruža li ambalaža još uvijek potrebnu zaštitu.

corrections.source: Imagine a seller invoice of 150 in the seller's currency, plus 10 for domestic delivery. If you paid those amounts directly, your running purchase cost is 160. Entering 150 as an item value on a forwarding worksheet does not raise the running cost to 310. Add actual new charges when they occur, identifying the service and currency for each. These figures illustrate bookkeeping only; the applicable amounts come from your own order.
corrections.translation: Zamislite da račun prodavača iznosi 150 u njegovoj valuti, uz još 10 za domaću dostavu. Ako ste oba iznosa platili izravno, dosadašnji trošak kupnje iznosi 160. Upisivanjem iznosa 150 kao vrijednosti robe u obrazac za prosljeđivanje trošak ne raste na 310. Nove naknade zbrajajte kad stvarno nastanu i za svaku zabilježite uslugu i valutu. Brojke su samo primjer vođenja evidencije. Za vlastitu kupnju upotrijebite iznose iz svoje narudžbe.

corrections.source: Superbuy's shipping calculator requests the destination, warehouse, weight, size and item category. Use the same inputs as the measured parcel when comparing the resulting options. Weights shown in kilograms may require conversion if the form asks for grams. One kilogram equals one thousand grams. Copying 2.4 into a grams field misstates the input by a factor of a thousand.
corrections.translation: Kalkulator dostave Superbuya traži odredište, skladište, masu, dimenzije i kategoriju artikla. Kada uspoređujete mogućnosti, upotrijebite iste podatke izmjerenog paketa. Ako je masa prikazana u kilogramima, a obrazac traži grame, preračunajte je. Jedan kilogram iznosi 1000 grama. Upišete li za paket od 2,4 kg broj 2,4 u polje za grame, navedena će masa biti tisuću puta manja od stvarne.

corrections.source: Suppose the request asked for chest width on a closed jacket laid flat. The returned picture shows a tape around the outside of an open jacket on a hanger. It may be a legitimate measurement, but it does not answer your comparison with a garment measured flat. Explain the difference and ask whether the original view can be supplied under the selected service. Avoid assuming another charge is due or a refund is guaranteed until the actual terms and response are clear.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo da ste zatražili širinu u području prsa na zakopčanoj jakni položenoj ravno. Na primljenoj fotografiji mjerna traka obavija otkopčanu jaknu na vješalici. To samo po sebi može biti valjano mjerenje, ali ne omogućuje usporedbu s vašim odjevnim predmetom izmjerenim na ravnoj podlozi. Objasnite razliku i pitajte može li se u okviru odabrane usluge dobiti izvorno zatraženi prikaz. Provjerite uvjete i pričekajte odgovor prije nego što pretpostavite da treba nadoplatiti ili da vam je povrat zajamčen.

corrections.source: If the arrangement is ambiguous, ask for an inventory check that someone can carry out. An example request is: “For the warehouse entry linked to the domestic waybill ending 482, please confirm whether it contains two lamp bases and whether any fittings packets were recorded with them.” Include the full reference in the private inquiry. Keep the question about contents separate from a second question about damaged finish or measurements. Each has a different piece of evidence that can settle it.
corrections.translation: Ako raspored nije jasan, zatražite konkretnu provjeru sadržaja. Primjerice: „Za skladišni zapis povezan s domaćom pošiljkom čiji broj završava na 482 provjerite sadrži li dva postolja za svjetiljke i jesu li uz njih evidentirane vrećice s dijelovima za montažu.“ U privatnom upitu navedite cijelu oznaku. Pitanje o sadržaju odvojite od pitanja o oštećenoj završnoj obradi ili dimenzijama. Svako traži drukčiju provjeru.

corrections.source: Suppose a seller lists a box as 420 by 260 by 150 millimetres and the scale reads 1.80 kilograms. Its corresponding inputs are 42 by 26 by 15 centimetres and 1,800 grams. If one side is accidentally entered as 150 centimetres, the box in the calculator becomes ten times taller than the box on the desk. A disappearing route or implausibly high figure can be a reason to recheck units before assuming the carrier has changed its prices.
corrections.translation: Prodavač navodi kutiju dimenzija 420 × 260 × 150 mm, a vaga pokazuje 1,80 kg. U polja za centimetre i grame unesite 42 × 26 × 15 cm i 1 800 g. Upišete li greškom 150 cm umjesto 15 cm, kalkulator računa s deset puta višom kutijom. Ako neka ruta nestane ili procijenjena cijena izgleda neobično visoka, provjerite jedinice prije nego što zaključite da je prijevoznik promijenio cijene.

corrections.source: Suppose two purchases appear in your marketplace history with almost identical titles and consecutive order dates. On one, the waybill ends in 381; on the other, it ends in 318. A glance at the first digits may suggest that both refer to the delivery you just received. Compare the entire string. When you later write to support, paste the complete number rather than the last three digits used in your private notes.
corrections.translation: U povijesti kupnje imate dvije gotovo isto naslovljene narudžbe poslane dva dana zaredom. Broj jednog tovarnog lista završava na 381, a drugog na 318. Pogledate li samo prve znamenke, moglo bi vam se učiniti da se oba odnose na pošiljku koju ste upravo primili. Usporedite cijele brojeve. Kad pišete podršci, zalijepite puni broj, a zadnje tri znamenke koristite samo kao kraticu u vlastitim bilješkama.

corrections.source: I paid the seller directly. Which Superbuy service should I look at?
corrections.translation: Platio sam izravno prodavaču. Koju uslugu na Superbuyu trebam odabrati?

corrections.source: Read the parcel forwarding guide. It covers items you bought yourself and need received at a Superbuy warehouse. A shopping agent order instead asks Superbuy to make the purchase.
corrections.translation: Pogledajte vodič za prosljeđivanje paketa. Namijenjen je robi koju ste kupili sami i koju treba preuzeti skladište Superbuya. Kod kupnje preko posrednika tražite da Superbuy umjesto vas kupi proizvod.

corrections.source: Should I register a forwarding request for an item Superbuy bought for me?
corrections.translation: Trebam li prijaviti prosljeđivanje za proizvod koji je za mene kupio Superbuy?

corrections.source: Superbuy says that a purchase made through its shopping agent service does not require a separate forwarding submission. Check the shopping order and its warehouse status first.
corrections.translation: Prema uputama Superbuya kupnja putem njihova posrednika ne zahtijeva zaseban zahtjev za prosljeđivanje. Najprije provjerite narudžbu kupnje i njezin skladišni status.

corrections.source: Imagine a listing for sketchbooks with “black A5, dotted” and “black A5, blank.” The thumbnail can be identical because it shows the closed cover. If your requirement is blank paper, the word at the end is the decisive feature. Save the complete option text. A hand-written note saying “black notebook” loses precisely the detail that the warehouse may later need to verify.
corrections.translation: Oglas za blokove za crtanje može nuditi „crni A5, točkaste stranice“ i „crni A5, prazne stranice“. Sličica može biti ista jer prikazuje zatvorene korice. Želite li papir bez otisnutih oznaka, presudan je kraj opisa. Sačuvajte cijeli naziv varijante. Bilješka „crna bilježnica“ izostavlja upravo detalj koji će skladište možda trebati provjeriti.

corrections.source: For example, a seller may send a notebook today and its separately ordered refill tomorrow. The seller order can be the same on both dispatch notices while the carrier numbers differ. To check whether both pieces arrived, match each waybill and then compare the contents of the warehouse entries. An account search for the ordinary-language title “notebook” alone may miss a refill entered under a different name.
corrections.translation: Prodavač može danas poslati bilježnicu, a sutra zamjenske listove koje ste naručili zasebno. U obje obavijesti može biti isti broj narudžbe kod prodavača, ali različiti brojevi za praćenje. Kako biste potvrdili dolazak oba dijela, povežite svaki tovarni list s odgovarajućim skladišnim zapisom pa usporedite sadržaj. Pretražite li račun samo po riječi „bilježnica“, možda nećete pronaći listove evidentirane pod drugim nazivom.

corrections.source: That comparison describes geometry only. Whether a particular carrier uses dimensional billing, how it converts volume into a billing weight, how it rounds and how much it charges are separate questions. Read the selected route rules instead of borrowing a divisor from a different carrier's tutorial. A 41 percent increase in volume does not prove that freight increased by 41 percent. The actual weight, route limits and rate bands may matter more.
corrections.translation: Usporedba opisuje samo geometriju kutije. Posebno provjerite primjenjuje li prijevoznik volumetrijsku masu, kako je izračunava i zaokružuje te koju tarifu naplaćuje. Pročitajte uvjete odabrane rute umjesto da preuzmete djelitelj iz uputa drugog prijevoznika. Rast volumena od 41 % ne dokazuje da je prijevoz poskupio 41 %. Stvarna masa, ograničenja rute i tarifni razredi mogu imati veću ulogu.

corrections.source: An order note works best when it identifies an option the agent can check. Instead of “as pictured,” write the original seller option followed by your explanation of what matters. For a sketchbook, that might be “black cover, A5, blank pages; please ask before replacing with dotted paper.” If the seller allows customization, reproduce spelling and case carefully and specify any uncertainties before payment.
corrections.translation: U napomenu unesite varijantu koju posrednik može provjeriti. Umjesto „kao na slici“ prepišite oznaku prodavača i objasnite što vam je važno. Za blok za crtanje, primjerice: „Crne korice, A5, prazne stranice. Pitajte me prije zamjene točkastim papirom.“ Ako prodavač nudi personalizaciju, točno prenesite pravopis te velika i mala slova i razjasnite nedoumice prije plaćanja.

corrections.source: An availability decision and a packing decision are separate. You might know exactly where every unit is but still need to decide whether partial international delivery serves your purpose. For a modular lamp, shipping the bases without fittings can leave you with two unusable pieces at home. For several independent notebooks, an early partial shipment may be more practical. Describe the consequence of dispatching the available pieces before comparing prices.
corrections.translation: Dostupnost i odluka o slanju odvojena su pitanja. Čak i kad znate gdje je svaki komad, treba odlučiti odgovara li vam djelomična međunarodna pošiljka. Ako pošaljete dvije baze modularne svjetiljke bez dijelova za pričvršćivanje, kod kuće ih možda nećete moći upotrijebiti. S nekoliko zasebnih papirnatih bilježnica ranija isporuka dijela narudžbe može biti korisna. Prije usporedbe cijena procijenite što dobivate slanjem trenutno dostupnih komada.

corrections.source: Once goods are stocked, Superbuy's guides direct users to My Warehouse. Inspect item names and photographs alongside your box map. Decide what each picture actually shows. A closed retail carton labelled “shade set” can support identification of a carton without establishing the count or condition of its contents. A visible pair of shades does not establish that both fittings packets are present.
corrections.translation: Nakon što roba uđe u skladišnu evidenciju, vodiči Superbuya upućuju vas na My Warehouse. Usporedite nazive proizvoda i fotografije s vlastitim popisom kutija. Natpis „komplet sjenila za svjetiljke” pomaže prepoznati zatvorenu prodajnu kutiju, ali ne potvrđuje količinu ni stanje sadržaja. Čak ni fotografija obaju sjenila ne potvrđuje da su stigle obje vrećice s dijelovima za montažu.

corrections.source: Check its order and contact the relevant service first. Clearly identify the affected unit and ask what remedies remain while it is still at the warehouse. Keep it off the dispatch selection until you have made a decision.
corrections.translation: Pronađite narudžbu i najprije se javite odgovarajućoj službi. Navedite točan primjerak i pitajte koje su vam mogućnosti dok je još u skladištu. Nemojte ga uključiti u otpremu dok ne odlučite kako postupiti.

corrections.source: Only as a rough comparison. Match the destination, date, route, parcel dimensions, weight and service options. Your own live quote is the relevant estimate for your shipment.
corrections.translation: Samo za okvirnu usporedbu. Provjerite podudaraju li se odredište, datum, ruta, dimenzije, masa i odabrane usluge. Za svoju pošiljku provjerite aktualnu ponudu prema njezinim podacima.

corrections.source: For a two-box comparison, calculate each rectangular volume separately before adding them. Multiplying the sum of the lengths by the sum of the widths and heights produces an imaginary oversized box. Only use the measured dimensions of a single combined carton if the warehouse has actually combined the goods that way. Keep each individual carton measurement beside its corresponding quote.
corrections.translation: Pri usporedbi dviju kutija izračunajte obujam svake zasebno pa zbrojite rezultate. Množenjem zbrojeva duljina, širina i visina dobili biste izmišljenu preveliku kutiju. Mjere jedne zajedničke kutije koristite samo ako je skladište u nju doista spakiralo robu. Uz mjere svake kutije sačuvajte odgovarajuću ponudu za prijevoz.

corrections.source: Before submitting for overseas delivery, compare the final selection with the measured one. Did another item arrive? Did you ask staff to keep a box that the first estimate removed? Did the destination change? Each is a reason to revisit the quote. The benefit of a rehearsal is knowing what was measured and being able to use that observation. A precise request gives you a decision you can make confidently even when the cheapest eligible route is different from the one you originally expected.
corrections.translation: Prije slanja u inozemstvo usporedite konačni popis robe s onim što je izmjereno. Je li pristigao još jedan proizvod? Jeste li zatražili da zadrže kutiju koju su prvi put uklonili? Je li promijenjeno odredište? U tim slučajevima ponovno provjerite ponudu za prijevoz. Probno pakiranje pokazuje što je točno izmjereno, pa možete odlučiti čak i ako je sad neka druga dostupna ruta najjeftinija.

corrections.source: Keep a short line for each request with the warehouse or parcel reference, date, requested action, service selected, amount and expected result. If you asked a question but have not accepted an option, record the status as awaiting an answer. If a service was accepted, save the confirmation that identifies it. These notes help when several items are almost identical or when a support conversation covers more than one service.
corrections.translation: Za svaki zahtjev upišite oznaku skladišne stavke ili pošiljke, datum, traženu radnju, odabranu uslugu, iznos i očekivani rezultat. Ako još niste prihvatili opciju, zabilježite da čekate odgovor. Za dogovorenu uslugu sačuvajte potvrdu. To olakšava provjeru kada imate nekoliko gotovo jednakih proizvoda ili s podrškom razgovarate o različitim uslugama.

corrections.source: This record becomes especially valuable after delivery. If the gift sleeve is missing, you can show which unit required it and what instruction was accepted. If a packing treatment worked well, you can describe the successful arrangement in a future request rather than relying on an ambiguous service name. Optional services are easiest to manage when every instruction has an identifiable object and every completed request has a result you can actually inspect.
corrections.translation: Bilješka je osobito korisna poslije dostave. Ako nedostaje ukrasni zaštitni ovitak, možete pokazati za koji je primjerak bio namijenjen i koja je uputa prihvaćena. Ako je pakiranje dobro funkcioniralo, u idućem zahtjevu opišite kako je roba zapakirana. Navedite na što se odnosi svaka uputa i provjerite rezultat svake izvršene usluge.

corrections.source: Check the current storage information for each entry in your account. Arrival, intake and the deadline displayed for that specific entry are more useful to you than the date you first found the product online. An older item can be approaching a decision point while a newly stocked item from the same seller has more time available. A single date attached to the planned parcel hides that difference.
corrections.translation: Provjerite trenutne podatke o pohrani za svaki unos na računu. Dolazak, unos i rok prikazani za taj određeni unos korisniji su vam od datuma kada ste prvi put pronašli proizvod na internetu. Starija se stavka može približavati točki odlučivanja, dok novododana stavka istog prodavatelja ima više vremena na raspolaganju. Jedinstveni datum vezan uz planiranu pošiljku skriva tu razliku.

corrections.source: A useful order of priorities is physical constraints first, preferences second and a request for advice if both cannot be met. For instance: “The book must stay flat with its sleeve. If a smaller carton would require bending the cover, keep the larger carton and return its measurements.” This gives the packer permission to preserve the important requirement while still helping you compare the result.
corrections.translation: Najprije navedite fizička ograničenja, zatim želje. Ako se ne mogu uskladiti, tražite savjet. Primjerice: „Knjiga mora ostati ravna u svom zaštitnom ovitku. Ako bi se za manju kutiju morale saviti korice, ostavite veću i javite mi njezine dimenzije.” Tako osoblje zna što mora sačuvati, a vi možete usporediti rezultat.

corrections.source: Before submission, transfer only the instructions that apply to the chosen parcel. A note to retain a collector's sleeve belongs with the specific book. Reinforcement of an outer carton concerns the entire parcel. Describe the object and action together so that one instruction does not inadvertently override another, particularly when removing some packaging while keeping other pieces intact.
corrections.translation: Prije slanja pošaljite samo upute koje se odnose na odabrani paket. Bilješka za zadržavanje zaštitnog ovitka kolekcionarske knjige pripada s određenom knjigom. Ojačavanje vanjske kutije odnosi se na cijeli paket. Opišite objekt i akciju zajedno tako da jedna uputa nenamjerno ne nadmašuje drugu, osobito kada uklanjate neke ambalaže, a druge dijelove držite netaknute.
